verdict.rationale: Core card lifecycle work is API-driven: cards are issued by creating paymentInstrument resources, balance accounts are updated via /paymentInstruments/{id}, and disputes have an API. Transaction rules and webhooks are also documented. However, the docs show tasks that must be done in the Customer Area, not the API: configuring relayed authorisation webhooks, uploading dispute evidence zip files, and viewing card payments. That means full UI-to-API parity is not delivered. Missing for 10: API-based configuration of relayed authorisation, API upload of dispute evidence, API equivalent for viewing card payments shown in the Customer Area, and any documented statement of API/UI parity.
